name: Viceroy
summary: Fantasy card-auction game where players build a pyramid to gain power points over 12 turns.
rules_text: The game lasts 12 turns, each with two simultaneous phases. There are four up for auction character cards placed next to four colored auction cards. In the auction phase players simultaneously bid a hidden gemstone of the matching color or pass. If a color is bid by exactly one player, he takes one of the two cards of that color. If contested, bids return to the supply and bidders go to a second, then third auction. Max one card won per turn. In the development phase players may play up to three cards from hand into their personal pyramid. The pyramid starts with one card; new cards are added left/right of base or on top of two cards below forming a colored circle. Each placed card gives an immediate reward of gems, tokens or points. Law cards from hand give special effects. Pyramid order cannot change. After 12 turns players sum power point tokens and card bonuses; highest total wins.
